_README: Edit the four fields below, then save and run SSN Overlay.exe. The app needs `session` and `twitchChannel` at minimum. `streamElementsJwt` and `streamlabsSocketToken` are both OPTIONAL — fill in whichever donation service you use (or neither if you don't). Find each: SE JWT at StreamElements dashboard -> profile -> Channels -> Show secrets -> JWT Token. SL token at streamlabs.com/dashboard#/apisettings -> API Tokens -> 'Your Socket API Token'. Right-click the tray icon (bottom-right, near the clock) for per-window toggles and other actions. Hotkeys: Ctrl+Shift+O = edit mode, Ctrl+Shift+H = hide/show all, Ctrl+Shift+Q = quit. The game you're playing must run in BORDERLESS WINDOWED mode (exclusive fullscreen blocks the overlay).
